budget._note: Money caps. The free plan spends nothing; raise these only if you route shots to Kling 4.

kaggle._note: username: your Kaggle username. weekly_gpu_hours stays under Kaggle's ~30 h so a stuck run cannot use it all. max_queue_hours: when a second GPU backend is connected, a batch still waiting for a Kaggle GPU after this long is handed to it.
kaggle._stages_note: Only these stages run on Kaggle. refs and keyframes are off: on 26 Nov, with the decoder in fp32, all 24 stills still went NaN at step 1 inside the transformer (fp16; T4s have no bf16). Qwen-Image needs an Ampere-or-newer GPU.

refs._note: Qwen-Image-2512, Apache 2.0, 50 steps with CFG for quality. The first GGUF in `prefer` that fits the GPU is used (A100 40 GB: Q8_0; L4: Q6_K). Needs bf16: Ampere or newer, or Apple Silicon (mac backend).

fal._note: Paid fallback only. Endpoint ids are NOT verified; check each before a paid run.

refs._note: Gate 1: reference stills painted on Kaggle from style_bible/ref_prompts.json when style_bible/refs/ lacks them.

mac._note: Your Mac renders previews offline with mflux (docs/mac-worker.md): Z-Image Turbo (6B, Apache 2.0) for stills and FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (Apache 2.0) for keyframes, both unquantized so there is no grain, fast on a 32 GB Mac. Final renders stay on Colab with Qwen. The Qwen 4-bit setup tested on 2026-11-27 (grainy, 20-60 min an image) is kept as engines_qwen4bit; engines_8bit needs 48 GB or more.

The producer sizes each batch to what is left of total_cap_units (the owner's agreed budget: 100 units = $9.99); the runner will not start a VM below min_balance_units. Rates are units per GPU-hour as Colab charged them in 2026.
colab._gpus_note: bf16 GPUs only (T4 makes Qwen go NaN). Rates (2026): L4 1.71, A100 40GB 5.40 units/h. G4 (8.71/h) left out: dearer than an A100 and it would make the cap count every batch at its rate. H100 is not offered to this account.

cgi._note: The 3D CG pipeline (docs/cgi-pipeline.md): Blender renders every shot from the same character models, props and sets, driven by acting sheets (style_bible/acting.json) and captured performances, so shots are coherent by construction and render natively in 4K on the Mac. Defaults are in pipeline/cgi/config.py; anything set here wins. blender: path to Blender 5.x (empty: /Applications/Blender.app, then PATH). use_in_cut: assemble uses media/cgi/<shot>/<shot>.mp4 renders before takes and keyframes.
